title: Player Workstation
description: A Minecraft mod that allows you to access calculator, notepad, crafting list and tools that you can create your own rule.
body:
# Player Workspace

An all-in-one workspace mod for Minecraft. Press **P** to open a fast, in-game overlay with four tools.

## Features

### Calculator
- Expression evaluation with parentheses and operators (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`)
- On-screen buttons for quick input
- History of past calculations (persistent across sessions)

### Notepad
- Create, edit, and delete notes in-game
- Titles and content are saved automatically
- Configurable max notes and note length (via ModMenu)

### Crafting Guide
- Search any item by name or ID
- Pin items to your HUD for quick reference
- Multiple pinned items shown stacked on-screen
- Configurable pin position (via ModMenu)

### Tools
- Custom calculation tools using formulas with `x` as input
- Built-in examples: Nether/Overworld distance, stack size calculator, block/ingot conversion, minutes to seconds
- Test formulas live before saving
- Wiki with usage instructions

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.0+
- Fabric API (any version for 26.2)
- ModMenu (optional, for settings screen)

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2
2. Download Fabric API for 26.2 and place it in your `mods` folder
3. Download Player Workspace and place it in your `mods` folder
4. (Optional) Download ModMenu for the settings GUI

## Configuration

Settings can be changed in-game via ModMenu, or directly in
`.minecraft/config/playerworkspace.json`:

- `pinX` / `pinY`: HUD pinned items position
- `maxNotes`: Maximum number of notes
- `maxNoteLength`: Maximum characters per note

## Key Bindings

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| P | Open workspace overlay |
